title: Slovakian Chicken Wrap
description: A hearty and flavorful wrap filled with chicken, leafy greens, and a tangy Slovakian-inspired sauce.

ingredients.name: leafy greens (such as lettuce and spinach)

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped leafy greens, dissolved bouillon, and sliced chicken.
Warm the wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or according to package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the chicken and greens mixture onto the center of the wrap.
